page.layout: One page of text in a single column, Greek and Latin glosses with Anglo-Saxon/English words in black letter; a few marginal marks on the right and left edges (ink smudges, not text). Running head at top; page number at top right; signature at foot.

main_text.p: Σιδηρος, & σιδηροφορεῖν. vide suprà. Σφεντὸς, flexilis, &c. σφενδὰ, armillæ, monilia, torques: funiculi, fibulæ, ut quidam apud Homerum exponunt; strap.
Σκαιὸς, lævus, finister; ineptus, perversus, σκόλιος. Anglis, a squint, & a-skew, limus, obliquus.
Σχεδὸς, ἀχλὺς, ἀισχαλὸς: (Hesych.) i. portus, littus; a shore.
Σβυρὸς, acerbus, austerus; de sapo-ribus, proprie: & metaphoricè de homi-nibus; rugge: ut vulgò pronuntia-tur. Sed scribitur rough.
Σλαῖος, carina. Anglis, to steere, clavo affidere, navim gubernare; sterne, gu-bernaculum.
Σεμίλακες, simila, simila-go: unde simnel ducunt vulgata quædam Lexica. nam alioquin ex Latino quoque fieri potuit. ut & cracknell, & κολλύρα, col-lyra.
main_text.head: T
main_text.p: Τρίχω, cursus: Item locus in quo currítur: Σχὸς, rota. Angl. a track, semita; vestigia. to track; oz trace, ve-stigare.

page.notes: Greek words and some black-letter English words are reproduced from the scan as best legible; several Greek forms are uncertain and should be checked. Marginal ink marks on the left and right edges are not text.
